description: An elderly man with grey hair and side whiskers, in a dark coat and bow tie, holds a pinkish human brain in both hands and points one finger at its surface beside a bright window. A younger man in round spectacles and a dark suit stands behind him, holding a notepad and quill. On a wooden table at the lower left are a glass jar, a folded cloth, forceps and scissors. The style is a dark, painterly oil look with 19th-century dress and furnishings. There is no visible text, frame or border, and the painting runs edge to edge.
